title: andicolea lucida
intro: Andicolea lucida, commonly known as "Peruvian pepper," is a plant species native to the Andes Mountains in South America. As a medicinal plant, Andicolea lucida has been used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate pain and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, antiseptic, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. Andicolea lucida is rich in bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
